In --name mode the worktree folder is <main checkout>/<FOLDER>/<name>: FOLDER is AFK_WORKTREE_FOLDER, else worktree_folder of hooks/lib/providers/<afk_provider>.json (.claude/worktrees for claude, .codex/worktrees for codex), else .claude/worktrees; an absolute folder or one holding .. is refused; --parent is overwritten and ignored in this mode.

Exit contract: every refusal and every unexpected failure (ERR trap with set -eE) prints ERROR=<reason> on stderr and exits 1; success prints WORKTREE_PATH=<DEST> as the last stdout line, everything else goes to stderr; owner record, copied-file record, provisioning and WorktreeCreated script failures only warn.
A failure after `git worktree add` leaves the new worktree on disk: error_exit only exits and the EXIT trap only releases the creation lock.

--name mode alone takes the creation lock, branches from the session checkout's HEAD (main checkout's HEAD when the session is in another repository), makes an orphan branch when there is no commit, refuses a taken name or existing branch, writes the exclude entries and the owner record, and never opens the IDE; the branch is git.branch-template filled with the name (feat/<name> in this repository) or worktree-<name>.
